messages:
Maya H.: Heads-up: EdgeClient (VIP) launches next Tue 08:00 UTC. They're doing a 30k concurrent user ramp test Mon 22:00 UTC. I'm handing off coverage details here — non-incident watch but high-risk for latency/SLA.

Trent L.: thanks Maya. who's on primary for the 22:00->02:00 window? :)

Maya H.: Primary = Trent L. (22:00-02:00), Backup = Kim S. (02:00-06:00). I'll be on standby 20:00-22:00 for warmup and config checks.

Kim S.: got it. do we have any special model routing/fallbacks for EdgeClient? they requested quantized model to save cost but it's slightly slower for long prompts.

Maya H.: yes — plan: serve v2-quant on Dedicated pool A for most traffic, with fallback to v2-fp16 in same region if latency spikes. Routing policy: prefer lower-cost until p50 > 220ms then failover. See snippet below.

Maya H.: ```
# routing policy (simplified)
if p50_latency(region, model=v2-quant) > 220ms:
  route -> v2-fp16
else:
  route -> v2-quant
```

Raj P.: FYI the contract SLA for EdgeClient penalizes >300ms p50 at 99.9% uptime windows. We should pre-warm KV cache for most common prefixes (customer bot flows). I uploaded a short prompts list to S3 at s3://redwood-prod/edgeclient/warmup.txt

Trent L.: thanks Raj. I'll run the warmup script at 20:30 and verify cache hits. Which script?

Maya H.: use `scripts/warmup_kv.sh` in the infra repo — it takes the S3 path as arg. Command: `./scripts/warmup_kv.sh s3://redwood-prod/edgeclient/warmup.txt --parallel 50`

Trent L.: copying commands into my notes. Any playbook links for escalation?

Maya H.: yes — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edgeclient-launch. Key steps: rollback routing to v2-fp16, scale Dedicated pool A up by +40% via console, and open a PagerDuty incident if p50 > 400ms for >5m.

oncall-bot: Reminder — rotation swap for 2026-04-05 scheduled. Use `/swap-oncall Trent L.` to confirm.

Kim S.: quick check — will we disable autoscaling during the ramp? we should probably allow burst to avoid cold starts.

Maya H.: autoscaling = enabled but with higher max cap for the window. Policy updated in infra config: max_instances = 120 -> 180 for 22:00-02:00.

Trent L.: I'll monitor dashboards: route p50/p95, instance count, GPU mem pressure, and token throughput. I'll ping here every 30m during the watch and call out anything unusual.

Raj P.: I'll be reachable on call (pager) for SRE-level escalation; my cell is in the runbook. Also note: customer will have a long prompt variant hitting >4k tokens, that can blow past cache assumptions — watch tail latency.

Trent L.: noted. one last ask — who owns rollback for model variant? Maya?

Maya H.: I can do the rollback until 23:30 UTC. After that if I'm unreachable, Trent/Raj can proceed with the documented rollback steps in the runbook.

Trent L.: perfect. thanks all. I'll post a quick status at 21:00 after warmup and again at 22:00 when the ramp starts. :thumbsup:
